name: Profile card
what: A social profile card rises: the picture pops inside a turning story ring, the name and handle slide in, the posts / followers / following count up, the bio appears, and the Follow button gets clicked and turns to Following.

learned_from.what: a profile page building up with counts ticking and the Follow button clicked

motion: card up 16 f; picture back.out 12 f + the ring turns; counts 36 f (slow end); bio lines 6 f apart; the click: a 4 f dip, the button flips
